ENGLISH:
Guide to applying for a double major
1. Subject to application: Students who have completed the first-year course or higher at this school

2. Application period: Within the prescribed period of each semester (apply in January for the first semester and July for the second semester)

※ For a detailed schedule, please refer to the individual notice in the academic notice

3. Application procedures and methods

1) Complete the Double Major Application Form
2) Approval of the head of the affiliated department (department) and the head of the minor department (department)
3) Submission of application form to the school affairs team (main building No. 108)
4) Double major approval
5) Documents to be submitted: 1 minor application form, 1 transcript of transcript

4. a double major completion credit

1)The credit required for recognizing the completion of a double major shall be at least 42 credits from the undergraduate (department) major course (must complete the required major course).  (Must complete the course when designating the course)
2) Double major credits within the same department shall be 36 credits or more.  Those who have not obtained double major credits are not recognized for double major.
3) After calculating the grades at the end of the graduation semester, those who have completed a double major confirm the completion of a double major at the undergraduate department (department) and submit a confirmation of completion of a double major to the school affairs team (main office No. 108), and receive credit for a double major.
4) The same subject of main engineering and convergence major is not recognized as overlapping.

5. Double major related forms

Double major (applicant, cancellation, confirmation of completion) form
※ Confirmation of completion of double major shall be submitted after calculation of grades at the end of the fourth year's graduation semester

6. Notes

1) Double major changes and cancellations can be applied within the prescribed period of each semester (see the announcement of the academic announcement)
2) Double major subjects completed before applying for double major are also recognized as double major completion (depending on the year of application for double major)

A course in which a bachelor's course and a master's course can be completed within five or 5.5 years by shortening the period of study by linking the bachelor's course and the master's course

Five years of study: 3.5 years for bachelor's degree and 1.5 years for master's degree
5.5 years of study: 4 years of bachelor's degree program and 1.5 years of master's degree program

TITLE: 수강지도상담
CONTENT:
수강지도 상담
1. 목적

학기개시 전 다음학기에 대한 수강계획 상담을 통해 학사지도 및 관리를 강화하고, 효율적인 학점 취득 추구

2. 대상

해당학기 수강예정 학부생 전원(※ 단, 학기별 신·편입생은 입학한 첫 학기에는 상담 대상이 아님)

3. 기간

학사공지 게시판을 통하여 학기별 별도 공지(1학기 1월중, 2학기 7월 중)

4. 상담방법

역량관리시스템 내 수강지도상담 메뉴 이용

메뉴 위치 : 종합정보시스템 하단 메뉴 > 역량관리시스템 > 통합상담 > 지도교수상담 > 수강지도상담
수강지도상담은 반드시 역량정보시스템 내 수강지도상담 메뉴를 통하여 진행하여야 하며, 기타방법(이메일, 전화 등)의 상담은 미인정

5. 상담절차

가. 수강지도상담 작성 : 학기별 개설된 전공과목 중 학생 본인이 듣고자 하는 과목의 '신청(학생)'란에 체크하여 신청. 본전공 외 교양, 다전공 관련 사항은 '전공외'란 및 '내용'란에 줄글로 기입
나. 상담내용 검토 : 학생의 수강상담 신청내역이 학생의 학사 진행에 적절한지 지도교수가 검토 후 승인 또는 반려
(반려 시 '가. 수강지도상담 작성' 재진행)

다. 수강지도상담 완료 : 학생의 수강지도상담 신청 내역을 지도교수가 승인할 경우 상담 완료

6. 상담대상 과목

대상학기 개설된 주전공 과목

기타 과목에 대한 수강계획은 '전공외'란에 이비력
본인 수강 가능 학점 내에서 상담과목 선택

7. 기타 주의사항

■ 수강지도 상담 미완료시 수강신청 불가
■ 수강지도상담 과목 신청이 수강신청을 의미하는 것은 아니며, 실제 수강신청시 과목별 수강제한인원이 초과된 경우 수강지도상담 시 신청한 과목을 수강신청하지 못할 수도 있음에 유의바람

성적 경고자 상담
1. 대상

직전학기 성적경고자(평점 1.8미만)

2. 시기

학부(과)별로 상이

3. 방법

가. 학부(과)사무실 통해 지도교수와의 상담일정 수립 및 상담일지 수령
나. 지도교수 상담
다. 학부(과)사무실로 상담일지 제출

4. 기타 안내

성적경고자 상담 미완료시 수강신청 불가

Course guidance counseling
1. Purpose

Strengthen academic guidance and management through consultation on the course plan for the next semester before the start of the semester, and seek efficient credit acquisition

2. Target

All undergraduate students scheduled to take this semester ( ※ However, new and transferred students by semester are not eligible for counseling in the first semester of admission)

3. period

Separate notice for each semester through the academic bulletin board (in January of the first semester, in July of the second semester)

4. Consultation Method

Use of course guidance counseling menu in competency management system

Menu Location: Comprehensive Information System Bottom Menu > Competency Management System > Integrated Counseling > Advisor Counseling > Course Guidance Counseling
Course guidance counseling shall be conducted through the course guidance counseling menu within the competency information system, and counseling on other methods (email, telephone, etc.) shall be conducted Not recognized

5. Consultation procedures

go. Preparation of course guidance counseling: Apply by checking the 'Application (Student)' column of the subject you want to take among the major courses opened for each semester. Matters concerning education and multi-major in addition to the main major shall be entered in a row in the "non-major" and "contents" columns
I. Review of counseling contents: The advisor reviews whether the student's application for class counseling is appropriate for the student's academic progress and approves or rejects it
(Go for a companion poem). Re-proceeding 'Preparation of Course Guidance Counseling')

All. Completion of course guidance counseling: Consultation is completed when the advisor approves the student's application for course guidance counseling

6. Subjects subject to consultation

Subjects for the main course opened for the target semester

Course plans for other subjects in the 'Out-of-major' column
Select a consultation course within the credit available to you

7. Other precautions

■ Course registration is not possible if course guidance counseling is not completed
■ Application for course guidance counseling does not mean registration for classes, and if the number of students restricted for each subject is exceeded when actually registering for classes, it may not be possible to register for the courses applied for during course guidance counseling

Consultation with sexual warnings
1. Target

Performance grade of the previous semester (less than 1.8 rating)

2. the time

Different undergraduate departments

3. method

go. Establishment of consultation schedule with supervisor through undergraduate (department) office and receipt of consultation journal
I. counseling with one's supervisor
All. Submit a consultation journal to the undergraduate (department) office

Course cannot be registered if consultation for grade competitors is not completed

TITLE: 사회봉사과목
CONTENT:
사회봉사 과목이수안내
1. 사회봉사 이수방법

이론교육(4시간) + 봉사활동(34시간 이상)

2. 사회봉사 운영
이수구분 : 교양 선택
학점인정 : 1학점
비고 : “P”(Pass), “NP”(Non-Pass)

※ 수강신청 시 본인 최대수강신청 학점에 미포함
※ 재학 중 1회 1학점씩 총 2회 2학점까지 이수 가능
※ 성적산출시 취득학점에 포함, 평점평균 산정에 미포함
※ 연속 2회 “NP”일 경우 수강신청 불가

3. 사회봉사활동 인정기간

수강신청 직전학기 기말시험 시작일 ~ 수강신청 학기 기말시험 전까지(※ 헌혈은 기간제한 없음)

4. 사회봉사활동 기관 인정 범위

가. 시·도 및 시·군·구 자원봉사센터, 청소년활동진흥센터, 기타 사회복지관, 지역아동센터, 사회복지법인 사회복지봉사활동인증관리(VMS) 및
1365자원봉사포털에 등록되어 ‘사회복지 봉사활동 실적 인증서(VMS)’ 및 ‘자원봉사활동 확인서(1365)’가 출력되는 기관

VMS 출력 시 필히 ‘봉사자 실적 내역정보’ 출력하여 제출

니. 비영리민간단체(봉사활동확인서 제출 시 ‘비영리민간단체등록증’ 사본 첨부)

다. 해외봉사 : 인증된 국제 NGO단체

NGO(Non-Governmental Organization 비정부기구)는 지역-국가-국제적으로 조직된 자발적인 비영리 시민단체

라. 자원봉사센터 및 시민단체와 연계하여 하는 농촌봉사활동

마. 총학생회 주관 자원봉사

1학기 : 항공산타, 신입생새로배움터, 은익제 등
2학기 : 항공제, 하계방학 중 실시 한 사회봉사활동 등

바. 기타 부서 주관 대외행사 및 교내 자원봉사

입학관리팀 ‘모교입시 설명회’, 국제교류부 ‘Global-Buddy’, 항공우주박물관 ‘안내봉사’ 등

사. 헌혈활동 : 헌혈증 제출

1회 기준 4시간 인정
1학기 최대 2회(8시간)까지만 인정
추후 본교 재학생 중 필요한 학생 및 저소득층, 백혈병 소아암 협회, 관련 사회복지기관 등에게'항공대 재학생' 이름으로 기증

5. 사회봉사활동 미인정 범위

가. 공공기관, 행정기관에서의 봉사활동

공공기관 : 주민센터(구. 동사무소), 시.도.군.구청, 경찰서, 세무서, 소방서, 우체국 등
정부행정기관 : 국세청, 법원, 감사원, 국회 등

나. 도서관(단, 시각장애인을 위한 점자도서관은 인정), 어린이집, 경로당, 종교관련 봉사활동
다. 시·군·구 개최, 지역 개최 봉사활동(단, 교육과학기술부에서 공문화 되어 온 봉사활동은 인정)
라. 제출기간까지 봉사활동확인서가 미발급되거나 기간 및 시간이 정확히 기재되지 않은 봉사활동
(예 : 중앙일보 '공부의 신')

6. 제출서류

가. “사회봉사”과목 학점인정 서류

A person who has an average grade score of less than 1.80 at the end of the semester among students enrolled in the relevant semester
A person with an F grade of at least three subjects per semester

expulsion

Re-entry application information
1. Subject to application

Where a person who has dropped out or been expelled wishes to re-enter the school, permission may be granted only once if there is an extra capacity
(However, students before 2011 are excluded)
A person who has entered another school cannot apply for re-entry
Dropouts, disciplinary dropouts, and three consecutive grade warnings must be expelled more than one year after being expelled to apply for re-entry
2. Application period

Within the prescribed period of each semester (apply between December and January for the first semester and June and July for the second semester)
For a detailed schedule, refer to the academic notice 'Re-entry Application Guide'

3. Submission documents and where to submit them

Documents to be submitted: One copy of the re-admission application form and one copy of the reason for re-admission
Where to submit: School affairs team (Head Office No. 108)

4. re-admission procedures

Submission of application for re-entry (teaching team) → CraneDepartment (department) Re-admission deliberation → Individual notification of examination results → Payment of tuition fees for licensees → Course counseling and course registration

5. Notes

Re-admission semester will be decided after undergraduate (department) deliberation (re-admission is not allowed as desired semester)
Re-entry Permit Previous grades are invalidated according to the semester of the school year
ex) If the expulsion is allowed to re-enter the first semester of the third year after completing the second semester of the third year → The grades for the first and second semesters of the third year are invalidated

The grades of subjects retaken by retaking classes in the nullified semester will be changed to pre-acquired grades

6. Application Form

Re-entry Application Form

Deportation Guide
1. subject of expulsion

Unretired student (a person who has not returned to school more than four weeks after the expiration of the leave of absence)
Unregistered person (a person who has not registered within the prescribed date of each semester))
an enemy in a foreign school
A person who fails to complete a prescribed course within the enrollment period (16 semesters) (8 semesters for transfer students)
A person who receives a grade warning in the first semester that comes after receiving instruction in academic management in accordance with three consecutive magnetic warnings that have been expelled due to dropout or disciplinary action

2. Dropout application procedure (visit application only)

1) Complete the application form → Form is downloaded at the bottom or placed in the school affairs team 2) Consultation with the supervisor and the head of the department → After consultation, get a seal on the form's supervisor and head of the department ※ Consultation should be made individually by contacting the professor in charge (for related inquiries, contact the office of the department) 3) Check tuition and scholarship matters → Visit the finance team and student support team, respectively, and get a seal on the form 4) Application formOut (Teaching Team) → Acceptance of dropout after consent from the guardian

※ School affairs team (Head Office No. 108) / Finance team (Head Office No. 204) / Student support team (Head Office No. 205)

3. Note The return of tuition fees when dropping out is processed in accordance with the 'Regulations on the Operation of University Tuition.' If a student selected as a scholar drops out after not completing the relevant semester, the full scholarship must be returned (Tuition team 02-300-0032 / Scholarship related: Student support team 02-300-0023)

1. Subject to graduation examination

Students enrolled or graduates who have registered at least eight semesters (however, early graduates are included in the expected semester of graduation)
※Even if you have completed all your graduation credits, you cannot graduate while taking a leave of absence.

2. graduation credits
Target number: Until 2012
Graduation credits: A total of 140 or more credits; however, 134 credits for students with academic background and 6 credits for graduate school subjects

Target number: From 2013
Graduation credits: A total of 130 credits or more; however, 124 credits for students with academic background and 6 credits for graduate school subjects

3. Completion by area of liberal arts course

Required graduation requirements after 2013 academic year

Completion of all required educational requirements (essential liberal arts, aerospace specialization) is at least one subject per area of core liberal arts, and capacity building
For more information, see Class-> 'Completion of Liberal Arts' BaroFlag

4. Regarding the completion of a subject

Earning all credits for required liberal arts and major subjects
※ Refer to the undergraduate (department) website for required subjects by undergraduate (department)

Earn 57 or more credits in major courses
※ Major credits differ by department, so refer to each department's website

Average grade of 2.00 or higher for all grades
(However, early graduation is at least 4.00/academic-linked students are at least 3.5)

Satisfying graduation requirements required under the undergraduate (department) operation bylaws

5. Engineering Education Certification Program

It must meet the requirements for completion of the detailed rules for implementing engineering education certification.
See Engineering Certification Home Page and kauportal> 'Engineering Certification'

6. Early graduation

Overview

1) Related regulations: Article 28-2 of the School Regulations (early graduation), Article 34-2 of the Enforcement Regulations of the School Regulations (early graduation)
2) Graduation (early graduation up to one year) by shortening the duration of study as prescribed by university regulations

Eligibility to apply

1) a student who has obtained permission from the head of an undergraduate department after completing his second year

2) Students who have an average grade of 4.0 or higher for all grades upon graduation

※ Students with grade warning records cannot apply

Application time: Within a prescribed period of each semester
※ Please refer to the academic announcement for the detailed schedule. ※ Applications must be made before entering the 7th semester (not applicable during the 7th semester)
※ After completing the 'Early Graduation Application', the head of the department (department) is confirmed and submitted to the school affairs team

Graduation criteria

1) Students who have registered for at least 6 semesters at this university
2) Students who meet graduation requirements and graduation requirements and have an average of 4.0 or higher overall grades
3) Students without grade warning records ☞ Students with grade warning records cannot graduate early

7. completion system

Overview

1) Related Regulations: Article 34-3 (5) of the Enforcement Regulations of School Regulations
2) The academic records of students who meet the duration of the class and meet all the graduation requirements but do not pass the graduation certification system shall be completed.

completion status

Classification: Completion
Academic Status: Completion
Course registration status: Unable to apply
Registration status: Not registered
Main certificate of issuance: certificate of completion, transcript, expected graduation certificate

Graduation period after completion

1) A person who has completed the course shall be eligible for graduation each semester, and shall submit a graduation certification system within a prescribed date for approval
2) The degree is awarded at the end of the semester after reviewing the graduation situation in the same way as the enrolled student.
